nextAction: Jane Doe routes SOW-2 to Sunrise Foods for electronic signature.
fine: Correct AtliQ entity: Pvt Ltd for a India counterparty
Parties = invoicing entity: Pvt Ltd throughout
Governing law matches entity: laws of India (Pvt Ltd → Indian law)
Delay penalties capped: Cap 5% of milestone
No live AtliQ commitment covers this food work in India
Delay penalties match the 0.5% per week rate, are capped at 5% of the milestone fee, exclude client-caused delays, and are the sole remedy for delay.
Payment within 30 days of receipt matches the playbook standard.
IP ownership vests in the client upon payment, with AtliQ retaining ownership of background IP and granting a perpetual license.
The convenience termination clause ensures AtliQ is paid for all work performed up to the termination date.
Confidentiality obligations are mutual with a standard 3-year survival period.
The non-solicitation clause is mutual and limited to employees, which is acceptable.
Data protection liability is subject to the general aggregate cap, avoiding the risk of uncapped data incident liability.
The 7-day review period and deemed acceptance upon production use are in line with standard practice.

hits.heading: DELAY AND LIQUIDATED DAMAGES
hits.label: standard
hits.labelNote: Origin of the LD playbook: 0.5% of milestone/week, 5% cap, client delays excluded (Mar 2025)
hits.text:
7.1 If the Service Provider fails to complete a Milestone by the agreed date for reasons solely attributable to the Service Provider, the Service Provider shall pay liquidated damages at the rate of 0.5% (half percent) of the Milestone Fee of the delayed Milestone for each complete week of delay.

7.2 The aggregate liquidated damages in respect of any Milestone shall not exceed 5% (five percent) of the Milestone Fee of that Milestone.

7.3 No liquidated damages shall be payable where the delay is caused by the Client, including delayed access to data or systems, delayed review of Deliverables, or changes in scope, or by a Force Majeure event.

7.4 The Parties agree that the liquidated damages are a genuine pre-estimate of loss and shall be the Client's sole and exclusive remedy for delay.

hits.heading: SERVICE LEVELS AND SERVICE CREDITS
hits.label: standard
hits.labelNote: AtliQ-friendly master: capped liability, service credits capped at 5%
hits.text:
8.1 During the support period under any SOW, AtliQ shall meet the Service Levels set out in Schedule A.

8.2 If AtliQ fails to meet a Service Level in any calendar month for reasons attributable to AtliQ, Sunrise shall be entitled to Service Credits as set out in Schedule A.

8.3 The total Service Credits in any calendar month shall not exceed five percent (5%) of the Monthly Support Fee for that month.

8.4 Service Credits shall be applied against the next invoice and shall be Sunrise's sole monetary remedy for failure to meet the Service Levels. Service Credits are a price adjustment reflecting the reduced value of the Services and are not a penalty.

8.5 No Service Credit shall accrue for failures caused by Sunrise, its third-party vendors, scheduled maintenance notified in advance, or Force Majeure.
